name: interiores-ia
description: Diseño de interiores con IA: preview 2D de estilos + escena 3D editable con catálogo real.

scripts.build:types: npm run build -w @interiores/shared-types && npm run build -w @interiores/furniture-kit
scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:types && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:types && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
